arxiv-1906-07703.title: Indirect Chiral Magnetic Exchange through Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya–Enhanced RKKY Interactions in Manganese Oxide Chains on Ir(100)
arxiv-1906-07703.creator: Martin Schmitt, Paolo Moras, Gustav Bihlmayer, Ryan Cotsakis, Matthias Vogt, Jeannette Kemmer, Abderrezak Belabbes, Polina M. Sheverdyaeva, Asish K. Kundu, Carlo Carbone, Stefan Blügel, Matthias Bode
arxiv-1906-07703.description: Abstract Localized electron spins can couple magnetically via the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida interaction even if their wave functions lack direct overlap. Theory predicts that spin-orbit scattering leads to a Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya type enhancement of this indirect exchange interaction, giving rise to chiral exchange terms.

arxiv-2110-00791.title: Optimizing Neural Network for Computer Vision task in Edge Device
arxiv-2110-00791.creator: Ranjith M S, Dr. S Parameshwara, Pavan Yadav A, Shriganesh Hegde, Department of Electronics, Communication
arxiv-2110-00791.description: Abstract The field of computer vision has grown very rapidly in the past few years due to networks like convolution neural networks and their variants. The memory required to store the model and computational expense are very high for such a network limiting it to deploy on the edge device.

arxiv-2201-10001.title: E-ADDA: Unsupervised Adversarial Domain Adaptation Enhanced by a New Mahalanobis Distance Loss for Smart Computing
arxiv-2201-10001.creator: Ye Gao, Brian Baucom, Karen Rose, Kristina Gordon, Hongning Wang, John A. Stankovic
arxiv-2201-10001.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ye Gao, Brian Baucom, Karen Rose, Kristina Gordon, Hongning Wang, John A. Stankovic. In smart computing, the labels of training samples for a specific task are not always abundant. However, the labels of samples in a relevant but different dataset are available. As a result, researchers have relied on unsupervised domain adaptation to leverage the labels in a dataset (the source domain) to perform better classification in a different, unlabeled dataset (target domain).

arxiv-2402-18787.title: Enhancing the “Immunity” of Mixture-of-Experts Networks for Adversarial Defense
arxiv-2402-18787.creator: Qiao Han, yong huang, xinling Guo, Yiteng Zhai, Yu Qin, Yao Yang
arxiv-2402-18787.description: Abstract Recent studies have revealed the vulnerability of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) to adversarial examples, which can easily fool DNNs into making incorrect predictions. To mitigate this deficiency, we propose a novel adversarial defense method called “Immunity” (Innovative MoE with MUtual infomation & positioN stabilITY) based on a modified Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture in this work.

arxiv-2403-11118.title: Impact of Starlink constellation on Early LSST: a Photometric Analysis of Satellite Trails with BRDF Model numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , astropy ( Price-Whelan et al. 2018 ) , skyfield ( Rhodes 2019 ) , healpix ( Gorski et al. 2005 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) .
arxiv-2403-11118.creator: Yao Lu
arxiv-2403-11118.description: Abstract We report a simulation and quantification of the impact of the Starlink constellation on LSST in terms of the trail surface brightness using a BRDF-based satellite photometric model. A total of 11,908 satellites from the Gen1 and Gen2A constellations are used to focus on the interference to the initial phase of LSST operation.

arxiv-2407-11738.title: Strictly outer actions of locally compact groups: beyond the full factor case
arxiv-2407-11738.creator: Basile Morando
arxiv-2407-11738.description: Abstract We show that, given a continuous action α \alpha of a locally compact group G G on a factor M M , the relative commutant M ′ ∩ ( M ⋊ α G ) M^{\prime}\cap(M\rtimes_{\alpha}G) is contained in M ⋊ α H M\rtimes_{\alpha}H where H H is the subgroup of elements acting without spectral gap.

arxiv-2408-09268.title: On the age and metallicity of planet-hosting triple star systems
arxiv-2408-09268.creator: M. Cuntz, S. D. Patel
arxiv-2408-09268.description: Abstract We present a statistical analysis of the ages and metallicities of triple stellar systems that are known to host exoplanets. With controversial cases disregarded, so far 27 of those systems have been identified. Our analysis, based on an exploratory approach, shows that those systems are on average notably younger than stars situated in the solar neighborhood.

arxiv-2410-01010.title: Code Interviews: Design and Evaluation of a More Authentic Assessment for Introductory Programming Assignments Conference: Proceedings of the 56th ACM Technical Symposium on Computer Science Education V. 1; February 26–March 1, 2025; Pittsburgh, PA, USA Proceedings of the 56th ACM Technical Symposiu
arxiv-2410-01010.creator: Suhas Kannam, Yuri Yang, Aarya Dharm, Kevin Lin
arxiv-2410-01010.description: Abstract . Generative artificial intelligence poses new challenges around assessment, increasingly driving introductory programming educators to employ invigilated exams. But exams do not afford more authentic programming experiences that involve planning, implementing, and debugging programs with computer interaction. In this experience report, we describe code interviews: a more authentic assessment method for take-home programming assignments.

arxiv-2505-17414.title: A Dynamic Phasor Framework for Analysis of Grid-Forming Converter Connected to Series-Compensated Line Thanks: Financial support from NSF Grant Award ECCS 2317272 is gratefully acknowledged.
arxiv-2505-17414.creator: Fiaz Hossain and Nilanjan Ray Chaudhuri
arxiv-2505-17414.description: Abstract A dynamic phasor (DP) framework for time-domain and frequency-domain analyses of grid-forming converters (GFCs) connected to series-compensated transmission lines is proposed. The proposed framework can capture the behavior of GFCs subjected to unbalanced short circuit faults in presence of different current limiting strategies.

arxiv-2512-01808.title: Pair Transfer and Reaction Dynamics in 40,48 Ca + 96 Zr Collisions Below the Coulomb Barrier
arxiv-2512-01808.creator: Ibrahim Abdurrahman, Andrzej Makowski, Guillaume Scamps, Kyle Godbey, Piotr Magierski
arxiv-2512-01808.description: Abstract Sub-barrier fusion reactions are ideal for probing the effects of pairing correlations on simultaneous neutron transfer. Previous calculations using the BCS approximation showed an enhancement of pair transfer, relative to treatments with no pairing, but failed to reproduce the observed enhancement factor between one- and two-neutron transfer probabilities.

pmc-11396488.description: In addition to zinc oxide-based cements, resin-based materials are also available for temporary cementation. pmc-11592385.title: Comparative Analysis of Osteoarthritis Therapeutics: A Justification for Harnessing Retrospective Strategies via an Inverted Pyramid Model Approach
pmc-11592385.creator: Quinn T. Ehlen, Jacob Jahn, Ryan C. Rizk, Thomas M. Best
pmc-11592385.description: In this review, we seek to explore two distinct approaches to the clinical management of OA: a prospective approach, addressing primarily one’s genetic predisposition to OA and generating early intervention options, and the retrospective approach, aimed at halting or reversing OA progression post-symptom onset.

pmc-12666119.title: Opportunities and strategies for microsurgery training as a resident: Reflections and recommendations
pmc-12666119.creator: Hatan Mortada
pmc-12666119.description: Microsurgery training presents significant challenges for residents, who must navigate the dual demands of acquiring advanced technical skills and securing sufficient operating room (OR) exposure. This commentary draws on my personal experience as a plastic surgery resident with a keen interest in microsurgery to offer practical insights and recommendations.

pmc-13110077.description: Periodontitis is a chronic inflammatory condition that leads to tissue damage, bone loss, and gingival recession. In this disease, pH levels in the mouth are affected by food and saliva as well as tissue inflammation and damage caused by periodontitis.

pmc-13505747.title: Cyclen Tetra‐Amide Ligands as a Privileged Class of Ligands for Studying Second‐Sphere Coordination Environments
pmc-13505747.creator: Andrea L Batchev, Widana Kaushalya, Chashitha Padukka, Janya Subasinghe, Alice R Walker, Matthew J Allen
pmc-13505747.description: We propose that derivatives of cyclen tetra‐amides are a privileged class of ligands for large ions such as lanthanides that enable control over the second‐coordination sphere environment of discrete complexes. We demonstrate this concept first through highlighting examples of lanthanide cyclen tetra‐amide derivatives that provide control over three different second‐sphere environments.

pmc-13526425.title: Regulating Cells Fate and Function to Facilitate Bone Regeneration via Designing Programmable Bio‐Interactive Materials
